# Alcedo Studio

> Alcedo Studio is a free, open-source RAW editor and photo library for Windows and Apple Silicon Mac. Download the installer, read the documentation, or view the source code. Current version: 0.3.6, released on 2026-11-17. License: GPL-3.0.

Alcedo Studio runs on Windows 10 or 11 (x64; CUDA or OpenCL) and on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 13.3 or later (Metal).

## Download

- [Windows installer](https://static.aoraw.org/updates/v1/stable/builds/3009/windows-x86_64/AlcedoStudio-0.3.6-Windows-AMD64.exe): Alcedo Studio 0.3.6, .exe
- [macOS installer](https://static.aoraw.org/updates/v1/stable/builds/3009/macos-arm64/AlcedoStudio-0.3.6-Darwin-arm64.dmg): Alcedo Studio 0.3.6, .dmg for Apple Silicon
- [SHA-256 checksums for Windows](https://static.aoraw.org/updates/v1/stable/builds/3009/windows-x86_64/SHA256SUMS-windows-x86_64.txt)
- [SHA-256 checksums for macOS](https://static.aoraw.org/updates/v1/stable/builds/3009/macos-arm64/SHA256SUMS-macos-arm64.txt)
- [Release notes and older versions](https://github.com/zidage/AlcedoStudio/releases)
